units.source_text: 阴历三月上旬之巳日，谓之“上巳”，

en.t: The first Day of the Serpent in the first ten days of the third lunar month is called Shangsi,

units.source_text: 中国自古亦有修禊之俗。

en.t: and China too has had the custom of ritual purification from ancient times.

units.source_text: 临水祓除不祥，谓之修禊。

en.t: Going to the waterside to cleanse away ill fortune is called ritual purification.
